auth_required.description: Any POST or high-risk action requires Auth_Guard STRICT pass.
auth_required.rule: ACTIVE_CLAIMED state with valid L0 Proof.

ledger_required.description: Every execution attempt must have a corresponding ledger entry.

outcome_receipts.description: Final states must produce specific receipt types.

circuit_breaker.rule: If REJECTED receipt has http_status in breaker_codes within window -> Mode must be PROPOSE_ONLY.

no_silent_enqueue.description: If mode is PROPOSE_ONLY, enqueue must reliably fail or skip.
no_silent_enqueue.rule: T32 must refuse enqueue and optionally write REFUSED_ENQUEUE receipt.
